contracts.machine_check: Recompute all 1,536 ONNX medians and three per-space Spearman correlations; verify one released-checkpoint provenance record and preserved multi-metric summaries.
Require APPS n=512 and rho=0.9268067718469594; require KBSS n=512 and rho=0.5352789637599933 in the preserved paper-scale summary.
Recompute 17 separate 200-row CodeNet Spearman correlations and their unweighted mean; require mean rho=0.5298501742814378.

failure_semantics: Any missing row, unexpected space/language, changed median, changed metric, corrupt ZIP, or SHA-256 mismatch raises and exits nonzero.
